content.text:
Based on your example, here's the awk command:

```bash
awk -F'/' '{
  file = $(NF)
  sub(/\.html$/, "", file)  # Remove .html extension
  print "[" $0 "][" file "]"
}' static_html/reveal_config.html
```

This:
- `-F'/'` splits on forward slashes
- `$(NF)` gets the last field (filename with extension)
- `sub(/\.html$/, "", file)` removes `.html` extension
- Prints: `[path/to/file][filename_without_extension]`
